templates.title: Trackie
templates.name: trackie
templates.description: Trackie is a New Zealand Actual Budget server image. Sign-in is OpenID Connect, and optional per-user Akahu bank tokens are encrypted at rest.

env.name: ACTUAL_LOGIN_METHOD
env.label: ACTUAL_LOGIN_METHOD
env.description: Login method. Trackie self-host uses OpenID Connect.

env.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_ENFORCE
env.label: ACTUAL_OPENID_ENFORCE
env.description: Require the identity provider and disable password login.

env.name: ACTUAL_USER_CREATION_MODE
env.label: ACTUAL_USER_CREATION_MODE
env.description: Auto-provision a user on the first successful identity-provider login.

env.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL
env.label: ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL
env.description: OIDC discovery URL. The provider must return a verified email claim.

env.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID
env.label: ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OIDC client id. Register callback SERVER_HOSTNAME/openid/callback.

env.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME
env.label: ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME
env.description: Public URL of this server. Official compose uses port 5006. This listing publishes 20005 because 5006 is already used.

env.name: ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET
env.label: ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET
env.description: HMAC key that derives stored user identity from verified email. Do not rotate it.

env.name: ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET
env.label: ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET
env.description: Key that encrypts optional per-user Akahu tokens. Rotating it only forces users to paste tokens again.

env.name: TZ
env.label: TZ
env.description: Server timezone used to bucket transaction dates.
